summary:

The main page section is titled "검증 계정 압축 설정" and contains a large settings card titled "첨부파일 압축". Inside the card, there is a blue ON toggle switch next to explanatory text: "업로드 전 이미지·동영상 압축 기본 ON입니다. 압축하면 화질이 저하될 수 있습니다. OFF일 때는 이 화면의 용량 제한 이내인 원본만 사용하고, 초과 파일은 첨부할 수 없습니다. 중요한 미디어는 필요한 부분만 자르거나 크기를 줄여 첨부하세요." A bold notice says "지원되는 이미지·동영상의 압축이 ON입니다. 처리가 끝나는 동안 이 화면을 닫지 마세요." Additional body copy says the setting is saved to the logged-in account and loaded on another device, that the change applies after reopening the page, and that changing tabs should be followed by reloading. There is a subsection label "압축 방식" with a dropdown currently showing "용량 절약". Under it, helper text explains that only files over the limit are compressed, using lower quality/bitrate, while files within the limit remain original. A button below reads "계정 압축 설정 다시 불러오기".

Below the settings card is an upload area labeled "이미지 업로드" with a file picker line that says "Choose File step1-jpeg.jpg". A file status card beneath shows the filename "step1-jpeg.jpg" on the left and the state "처리 실패" on the right. Supporting text states "원본 7.3MB · 이 첨부의 최대 크기 2MB". An error message explains that processing was stopped to prevent quality loss and that preserving the original text/size/transparency cannot meet the size limit, advising to crop needed parts or choose a smaller original. A collapsed disclosure row reads "이유와 처리 제한 자세히". Below that is a section heading "에디터 캔버스 검증 대역" followed by a mostly empty content area, and at the bottom there is a large bordered text input/textarea containing "화질 보호 실패 후에도 유지되는 초안".

Layout structure: a simple single-column main content page with the account labels near the top, a large settings card in the upper-middle, an upload/result panel beneath it, then an editor/canvas validation area and a bottom text box. There is no visible sidebar, modal, or full app navigation chrome. Visual state: loaded, functional, and in an error/refusal state for the oversized file upload, but the UI is rendered and readable.

Verdict: pass. The screenshot shows the expected components with readable Korean text, clear hierarchy, no blank/crashed screen, and no severe clipping or broken layout. The processing failure state appears intentional and does not indicate a rendering problem.
